title: Terminology candidates schema (Asset F — Phase 1)
description: Schema for the Phase-1 output of the terminology-mining pipeline. Asset F has TWO files: (1) terminology-candidates-*.json — AR-side mined candidates with no EN translations (this schema). (2) domain-terminology.json — validated EN↔AR pairs promoted from candidates (separate schema, lands when first batch is paired). This schema covers the Phase-1 file. Candidates are NOT terminology — they are evidence that the AR term is real and used in the domain. EN translations come from Phase 2 (LLM-assisted pairing + corpus validation).

asset_name.description: Discriminates this from the (eventual) terminology-pairs asset.

domain.description: Domain tag: 'technology', 'news', 'business', 'politics', etc. Free-form to let consumers add domains without schema bumps.

ngram_size.description: Whether this candidate is a single token, two-token, or three-token phrase. Multi-token candidates are more likely to be real terminology.

sample_contexts.description: Up to 3 snippets showing how the term appears in the corpus (50-char windows). Populated for the top 50 candidates only to keep file size manageable.
